title: Nonlinear Landau-Zener Tunneling with Heat-Bath Colored Noise
summary: In this work, we investigate the influence of colored noise originating from a heat bath on nonlinear Landau-Zener (LZ) tunneling. The nonlinearity might arise intrinsically from many-body mean-field atomic self-interactions or Kerr nonlinearities in optical systems.
